description: Rename a doc, presentation or storyboard, file it in a space, or set who can open it. visibility org opens it to the team (ask your human first); a doc still in its task chat is filed in the chat space for that. visibility private also takes it off the web and out of its space's pins, and only its creator can set it.

doc_id.description: A doc id from get_task or list_space.

space_id.description: A space id from list_spaces to file it in.
